answer.answer: The supplied sources conflict. Delta Queue's documentation describes exactly-once delivery (snapshot delta-doc), but an incident report records that during incident DQ-17, some messages were delivered twice (snapshot delta-incident). Therefore, the documented exactly-once claim is not supported by the operational evidence supplied: at least during DQ-17, delivery was not exactly-once. The sources do not indicate whether the guarantee was subsequently fixed, changed, or re-qualified, nor do they specify the scope or conditions of the documented guarantee, so whether Delta Queue guarantees exactly-once delivery in current operation remains unresolved based on the supplied snapshots.
